subject: So many things went wrong with my order experience
body: Okay so first I ordered on a Tuesday I think, or maybe Wednesday, and then the website froze, and then I got an email, and then another email, and then the courier guy didn't knock, and then my neighbor said maybe he came, and then I checked the app twenty times, and then customer support asked me for screenshots which I sent, and then they asked again, and then the chat disconnected, and then I reinstalled the app, and then my payment method changed for some reason, and then I saw a charge I didn't recognize, and then I called my bank, and then I called you, and then hold music for ages, and then someone promised a callback that never came, and then the package appeared damaged, and then the return portal errored, and then I drove to the store but they said online-only, and then I posted on a forum, and then my cousin had the same issue last year, and then I started writing this email which is now very long because I want every single detail documented so nothing is missed when someone finally reads this and hopefully helps me get either a working product or my money back after this exhausting ordeal that has taken weeks of my time and patience and frankly should never happen to any paying customer in 2024 or whenever this is, thank you for reading all of this if you actually did.
